title: Beyond a single threshold: calibration of CADD v1.7 and AlphaGenome for ACMG/AMP computational evidence across variant classes, model versions, and reference data (code, analysis plan, and results)
description: Code, prespecified analysis plan with dated amendments, execution logs, script hashes, derived results, figures with source data, and supplementary tables for the ClinGen calibration of CADD v1.7 and the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score as ACMG/AMP PP3/BP4 evidence, with comparison against REVEL, BayesDel, and AlphaMissense, temporal hold-out, ClinVar variants of uncertain significance resolved after calibration, current ClinVar VUS, noncoding variant classes, model versions, and reference data. Third-party data (CADD, AVI, REVEL, BayesDel, AlphaMissense, ClinVar, gnomAD, HGMD, MaveDB, and others) are not redistributed; their sources, versions, checksums, and terms are listed in executed_pipeline/data_manifest.tsv and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The repository also keeps population-frequency analyses that are reserved for a separate study and are not reported in the article.
notes: Funded by Bupa Chile through the 1000 Genomas Para Chile project.
